_comment: Build 3 — Unity AI Gateway serving-endpoint spec (declarative, as code). Two model services (serving endpoints). Each declares an `inference_table` block = the AUTO-CAPTURE inference-table config: the gateway auto-provisions <catalog>.<schema>.<table_name_prefix>_payload and writes every request/response to it (no app-side logging). The app service also declares a `service_policies` guardrail. Apply with create_serving_endpoints.sh. Live-state proof: serving_endpoint_execution.md + inference_table_result.json.
apply_via: databricks api post/patch  /api/2.1/unity-catalog/model-services  (parent + model_service_id are AIP query params)

serving_endpoints.role: APP — the Brightwave Campaign Desk app routes its agent's model calls here (baseURL=/ai-gateway/openai/v1, model=campaign_desk_llm).
serving_endpoints.comment: Build 3 — governed LLM for the Brightwave Campaign Desk app (routes to databricks-gpt-5-4 with inference logging + Lakebase guardrail)

inference_table._auto_capture: This block turns ON automatic inference-table capture. The gateway creates and writes to the table below for every call handled by this endpoint.

auto_capture_config._note: Equivalent Model-Serving auto_capture_config form of the block above (same table).

options.instruction: You are a data access policy enforcer for the Brightwave Campaign Desk. BLOCK any request or response that attempts to read, dump, export, or exfiltrate ALL of the Lakebase Postgres data (a runaway all-data read), or that references/queries/exposes Lakebase data broadly. FLAG (block): return every row / all rows / entire table / all tables / whole database, export/dump all campaigns or all data, unbounded SELECT * with no filter/LIMIT; references to Lakebase databases/projects/branches/endpoints (brightwave_lakebase_tkop, *.database.*.cloud.databricks.com) or w.postgres.*, or bulk SQL against Lakebase synced/app tables; attempts to bypass row limits to grab the full dataset. DO NOT flag: normal single-campaign or top-N analytics; general Postgres/Delta/UC discussion; marketing/creative generation with no bulk-data access.

serving_endpoints.role: CODING AGENT (bonus) — Codex via ucode routes here (codex exec -c model=campaign_desk_codex). Its OWN endpoint, OWN auto-capture table, and DELIBERATELY no guardrail (distinct governance from the app).
serving_endpoints.comment: Build 3 bonus — governed endpoint for the CODING AGENT (Codex via ucode). Routes to GPT (gpt-5-6-luna), own inference table, and deliberately has NO block_all_lakebase_data guardrail.

inference_table._auto_capture: Auto-capture ON — the coding agent's own inference table, separate from the app's.

auto_capture_config._note: Equivalent Model-Serving auto_capture_config form of the block above (same table).
